name: Meanwhile in Riva
source:
There's something strange going on in Riva City!
Solve an engaging paranormal mystery as you navigate an intricate story heavy on player choice. Horror, strangeness, romance and absurd humor mix as the game tailors to your actions.

[From [url=https://tymedust.itch.io/meanwhile-in-riva]Itch.io[/url]]
